label: All human
summary: The work was created directly by a person, without AI shaping the output.

label: Human-led
summary: A person created the work and used AI only around the edges, without shaping the final substance.

label: Human-directed
summary: A person led the work; AI helped with limited supporting tasks.

label: Human-shaped
summary: A person substantially shaped AI-assisted material into the final work.

label: Mixed creation
summary: Human-created and AI-created parts were combined and reviewed as one work.

label: AI-assisted
summary: AI contributed meaningfully while a person directed and revised the result.

label: AI-guided
summary: AI produced a starting point or substantial material that a person directed and developed.

label: AI-shaped
summary: AI produced much of the material; a person made significant changes and decisions.

label: AI-produced
summary: AI produced the work with human direction limited to prompts, selection, or light revision.

label: Mostly AI
summary: AI produced nearly all of the work; human involvement was limited.

label: All AI
summary: The work was produced entirely by AI, with no meaningful human shaping of the output.
